claims.text: Porous wood has been used as a lightweight scaffold for magnetic iron oxide nanoparticles grown in situ.
You have developed hybrid graphenic and iron oxide photocatalysts for the decomposition of synthetic chemicals.
Your Fe3O4/GO, ZnO and TiO2 thin films removed tetracycline photocatalytically under UV LED, blue LED and solar light.
